data.title: Gal Gadot Defends Starring in Movie With AI Sets and Lighting Because ‘You’re Going to Work With It or Be Out of the Game’; Lawyers Spent 6 Months Ensuring AI Would Not Alter Actors
data.description: Gal Gadot says her lawyers spent six months on her 'Bitcoin' movie contract to ensure AI would not be used on her acting.
data.author: Zack Sharf
